comment: Each make target of CHECK_TARGETS declares its scope and the setup steps it needs: needs ["databases"] is a target that reads the servers of make orm-test-servers and the bench and decimal databases of the run, which the runner records as not-run, with the failed step and its first failure lines, when the setup steps servers, databases/create or go-lease fail; needs [] runs whatever the setup steps did. The other needs are the tools that the CI setup steps install (scripts/check/ci-setup.mts): go, go-lease, rust, php, php-min, composer, node-modules, interfaces-typescript, php-extension-tools and server-programs; when such a step fails in CI, the runner records the targets that need it as not-run with that step, and runs every other target. A local run has no CI setup steps. An owner target is a per-file check (format, checklist, documents, the unit tests of a checker): make owner-check runs it when a changed path matches its inputs. A suite target is part of the full suite only: make orm-check runs it once, and make owner-check never selects it; a changed feature's own verification and coverage run in its place. make owner-check and make repo-check fail on a target without a scope, an owner target without inputs, a suite target with inputs, and an input pattern that matches no tracked file. A pattern matches a repository path: * within one path segment, ** across segments.

.editorconfig.reason: the editor settings that orm keeps in the form of kit (scripts/repo/kit-copies.mts): the whitespace and line endings an editor applies; no test or tool of a check reads it

.githooks/commit-msg.reason: the commit-msg hook of orm: it runs make commit-msg-hook on the message being committed; no test reads it

.githooks/pre-commit.reason: the pre-commit hook of orm: it runs make staged-generated-hook on the staged paths; no test reads it

.github/runner.reason: it names the runner image of every job of the CI workflow, so it changes the machine that runs every target

.github/workflows/ci.yml.reason: it defines the CI jobs that install the toolchains and run make orm-check and the documentation checks, so it changes how every target runs in CI

.github/workflows/docs-pages.yml.reason: it builds and publishes the documentation site from every document on each push to main, so it changes the publication of every page

.gitignore.reason: it only decides which files git ignores; no test reads it, and owner-check and make orm-check list changed files through git

.golangci.yml.reason: the configuration of golangci-lint, which make lint-go reads in the full suite

.npmrc.reason: the setting of npm that allows the release URLs of package.json, which every npm ci of make install reads, so it changes the install of every Node and TypeScript target

.php-version.reason: it selects the PHP release of every check, locally and in CI, so it changes the runtime of every PHP target

LICENSE.reason: license text; no code or test reads it

clippy.toml.reason: the configuration of clippy, which make lint-rust and the clippy targets read in the full suite

composer.json.reason: the private Composer root that installs the PHP dependencies every PHP check loads through the autoloader

composer.lock.reason: it pins the PHP dependencies that every PHP check loads through the autoloader

config/duplication.json.reason: it declares the formats, the minimum and the excludes of make duplication-check, which reads every source file of the repository

config/generated.json.reason: it declares the generated paths, headers and module files that make layout-check and the pre-commit staged check read over every tracked or staged file

examples/go.mod.reason: it pins the modules of the Go examples and their output test

examples/go.sum.reason: it pins the module checksums of the Go examples and their output test

go.work.reason: it joins the Go modules legacy/packages/go, tests and examples, so every Go build and test resolves the orm packages from the checkout

go.work.sum.reason: it pins the checksums of the modules that the workspace of go.work resolves beyond the go.sum of its modules

knip.json.reason: the configuration of knip, which make lint-ts reads in the full suite

mise.toml.reason: its tool node selects the Node release of every check, locally and in CI, so it changes the runtime of every Node and TypeScript target

legacy/packages/go/go.mod.reason: it pins the Go toolchain and the modules of every Go build and test

legacy/packages/go/go.sum.reason: it pins the module checksums of every Go build and test

legacy/packages/go/internal/testdb/testd.reason: every Go database test opens its database through it, so it changes the setup of every Go database target

legacy/packages/python/uv.lock.reason: it pins the native uv development environment of the Python client used by its checks

legacy/packages/php-ext/testing/dbspec/a.reason: the dbspec apply runner of the PHP extension client, run by the cross-client runners (tests/dbspec/compare/runners.mts)

legacy/packages/php-ext/testing/dbspec/c.reason: the dbspec compare runner of the PHP extension client, run by the cross-client runners (tests/dbspec/compare/runners.mts)

legacy/packages/php-ext/testing/dbspec/i.reason: the dbspec introspect runner of the PHP extension client, run by the cross-client runners (tests/dbspec/compare/runners.mts)

legacy/packages/php/testing/dbspec/apply.reason: the dbspec apply runner of the PHP client, run by the perf test and the decimal physical check (scripts/perf-test.mts, scripts/decimal-physical-check.mts)

legacy/packages/php/testing/dbspec/compa.reason: the interface of the PHP compare runner, loaded by the PHP and PHP extension compare runners (legacy/packages/php/testing/dbspec/compare/php.php)
the dbspec compare runner of the PHP client, run by the perf test and the client database test (scripts/perf-test.mts, scripts/client-db-test.mts)

legacy/packages/php/testing/dbspec/intro.reason: the dbspec introspect runner of the PHP client, run by the perf test and the client database test (scripts/perf-test.mts, scripts/client-db-test.mts)

legacy/packages/php/testing/required_dsn.reason: the shared DSN helper of the PHP coverage cases (legacy/packages/php/tests/coverage_cases.php), which the PHP library and the PHP extension both run

packages/rust/case-clock/src/lib.rs.reason: every Rust test that checks the database clock takes its case clock from it

packages/rust/case-database/src/lib.rs.reason: every Rust database test creates and drops its case database through it

packages/rust/rustfmt.toml.reason: it configures rustfmt, which rust-fmt-check runs over every Rust file

packages/rust/programs/tests/all/main.rs.reason: the crate root of the one Rust test program: it generates the models and lists every test module as a group, so it changes which Rust feature cases compile and run

legacy/packages/ts/testing/dbspec/apply/.reason: the dbspec apply runner of the TypeScript client, selected by the feature check (scripts/features/check.mts, contracts/features.json)

legacy/packages/ts/testing/dbspec/compar.reason: the dbspec compare runner of the TypeScript client, selected by the feature check (scripts/features/check.mts, contracts/features.json)

legacy/packages/ts/testing/dbspec/intros.reason: the dbspec introspect runner of the TypeScript client, selected by the feature check (scripts/features/check.mts, contracts/features.json)

legacy/packages/ts/tsconfig.bootstrap.js.reason: scripts/typescript/build.mts compiles the generator sources with it before the models exist, so every make target and npm script that builds the TypeScript client reads it

rust-toolchain.toml.reason: it selects the Rust toolchain of every Rust build and test, locally and in CI

scripts/cargo-build-copy.mts.reason: every make target that runs a Rust program builds and copies that program through it (CARGO_COPY)

scripts/ci/php-extension-tools.mts.reason: the CI setup step php-extension-tools runs it to check the phpize and php-config with which the PHP extension polyspec_orm is built, so it gates the PHP extension targets in CI

scripts/ci/server-programs.mts.reason: the CI setup step server-programs runs it to install the programs of the database servers on the Linux runner, so it changes the servers of every database target in CI

scripts/clone-file.mts.reason: tests/cargo-test.mts and scripts/cargo-build-copy.mts copy every Rust test binary and program through it

scripts/free-ports.mts.reason: make orm-test-servers chooses the ports of the database servers of this checkout through it, so it changes the servers of every database target

scripts/publish-output.mts.reason: every make target that builds the lease program, the process tools, a stress document or a test binary publishes it through it (PUBLISH)

scripts/typescript/build.mts.reason: every make target and npm script that builds the TypeScript client publishes legacy/packages/ts/dist through it

tests/go.mod.reason: it pins the modules of the Go runners and physical tests under tests/

tests/go.sum.reason: it pins the module checksums of the Go runners and physical tests under tests/

tests/timezone/date.ini.reason: WITH_TEST_ENV adds it to the PHP ini scan path of every target that runs database clients, so it sets the time zone of every PHP client the suite starts

.mise/locks/npm-npm/12.2.0/.gitignore.reason: it keeps the packages that mise installs for the locked npm out of Git, so the install of make install-tools that every check runs on leaves a clean tree

.mise/locks/pypi-vulture/2.16/uv.lock.reason: it pins the packages of the vulture that make install-tools installs and lint-python runs over the whole Python package

mise.lock.reason: it pins the digest of every tool of mise.toml that make install-tools installs, so it changes the tools of every check, locally and in CI

config/toolchain.json.reason: it declares the PHP release, the symbol extractors and the mise release that make install-tools and make kit-install-symbols put in place for every check

config/rebuild.json.reason: it selects the tools whose class make rebuild-check checks over every tracked tool source

config/retained-branches.json.reason: make land reads it after every merge to keep the branches it pins; no check reads it

config/cargo.schema.json.reason: make layout-check validates every Cargo.toml of the repository against it

config/composer.schema.json.reason: make layout-check validates every composer.json of the repository against it
